title: On the Step Length Confounding in LLM Reasoning Data Selection
authors_zh: Bing Wang, Rui Miao, Chen Shen, Shaotian Yan, Kaiyuan Liu, Ximing Li, Xiaosong Yuan, Sinan Fan, Jun Zhang, Jieping Ye
paper_type_zh: 推理数据选择审计、去偏方法与数据发布
best_for_zh: 用似然或自然性分数整理多步骤推理监督微调轨迹的读者。
one_line: ASLEC removes step-length bias from likelihood-based reasoning-data selection by dropping or regressing out first-token effects.
ASLEC 通过丢弃或回归掉首词元效应，消除基于似然的推理数据选择中的步骤长度偏差。
why: It exposes how a formatting-dependent denominator can silently change which reasoning traces are trained on.
inclusion_reason: It audits and corrects the score that decides which verified multi-step reasoning trajectories enter SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Naturalness-based reasoning-data selection ranks a generated chain of thought by average log probability, perplexity, local log probability, or entropy under the target model. These scores are intended to retain trajectories that the target can learn from. In long reasoning traces, however, each new step begins with a low-probability branch token; when steps are longer, that first-token penalty is diluted by more continuation tokens. A selector can therefore prefer verbose step formatting rather than better reasoning.

This paper asks whether naturalness selection is confounded by the number of tokens per reasoning step, and how to correct the score before it decides which generated trajectories are used for SFT. The record is a question, a verified long chain of thought, final answer, token probabilities, and a step segmentation. The desired change is to the pre-SFT ranking rule, not to the answer verifier, the model architecture, or the inference-time decoding policy.

基于自然性的推理数据选择会按目标模型下的平均对数概率、困惑度、局部对数概率或熵，为生成的思维链排序。这些分数意在保留目标模型可从中学习的轨迹。然而在长推理轨迹中，每个新步骤都以低概率的分支词元开始；当步骤更长时，该首词元惩罚会被更多续写词元稀释。因此，选择器可能偏好冗长步骤格式，而不是更好的推理。

本文追问自然性选择是否被每个推理步骤的词元数混杂，以及怎样在它决定哪些生成轨迹用于监督微调前修正分数。记录是问题、经验证的长思维链、最终答案、词元概率和步骤切分。期望改变的是监督微调前排序规则，而不是答案验证器、模型架构或推理时解码策略。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The authors call the bias step length confounding. Across four source models, selected examples under existing naturalness rules have longer steps than unselected examples, while long steps receive higher average log probability. Their explanation is structural: the first token of a step often opens a new reasoning branch and has low probability, so a long step gives that penalty less weight in a token average.

ASLEC changes how the selection score handles those first tokens. ASLEC-DROP omits them before averaging log probability. ASLEC-CASL instead fits a causal-style linear regression in which the ratio of first tokens is a confounder, then subtracts its estimated influence from the global score. Both variants still prefer high-adaptability trajectories, but attempt to prevent a response from winning merely because its steps are longer.

作者将这种偏差称为步骤长度混杂。在四个来源模型中，现有自然性规则选中的例子比未选例子具有更长步骤，而长步骤获得更高平均对数概率。其解释具有结构性：一步的首词元常开启新的推理分支且概率低，因此长步骤在词元平均中给该惩罚的权重更小。

ASLEC 改变选择分数处理这些首词元的方式。ASLEC-DROP 在平均对数概率前将其省略。ASLEC-CASL 则拟合因果风格线性回归，将首词元比例作为混杂因素，再从全局分数中减去其估计影响。两种变体仍偏好高适应性轨迹，却试图阻止回复仅因步骤更长而获胜。

title: Method
方法
html:
For every candidate response, the pipeline segments the chain of thought into steps and computes model probabilities under the target model. ASLEC-DROP scores the response after excluding the probability of the first token in each step. ASLEC-CASL fits a regression using first-token and non-first-token probabilities plus the first-token ratio, then forms a deconfounded score by removing the ratio's fitted effect. Candidates with the highest corrected scores are selected for SFT; the regression has few parameters and the paper reports only seconds of additional fitting cost.

The LIMO-v2 experiment starts from 800 math problems, generates five correct responses per source model from QwQ-32B, Qwen3-32B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and gpt-oss-120b, then chooses five of twenty responses per question. AceReason-1.1-SFT uses 10K problems with one correct response per source model and selects 10K of 40K candidates. Correctness is checked during collection with Math-Verify; the study trains four target models and evaluates AIME 2024, AIME 2025, MATH-500, OlympiadBench, and GPQA.

对每个候选回复，流水线将思维链切成步骤，并在目标模型下计算概率。ASLEC-DROP 在排除每步首词元概率后为回复打分。ASLEC-CASL 使用首词元和非首词元概率以及首词元比例拟合回归，再通过移除该比例的拟合影响形成去混杂分数。分数最高的候选进入监督微调；回归只有少量参数，论文报告额外拟合成本仅需数秒。

LIMO-v2 实验从 800 道数学问题出发，用 QwQ-32B、Qwen3-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 gpt-oss-120b 各生成五条正确回复，再从每题二十条回复中选五条。AceReason-1.1-SFT 使用 10K 道问题，每个来源模型生成一条正确回复，再从 40K 候选中选 10K。采集期间用 Math-Verify 检查正确性；研究训练四个目标模型，并评估 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、MATH-500、OlympiadBench 和 GPQA。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper first shows that four existing naturalness selectors pick a distribution with longer reasoning steps than the unselected pool. On LIMO-v2 for Qwen3-4B-Base, Local LP reaches 36.50 average accuracy, ASLEC-DROP reaches 44.64, and ASLEC-CASL reaches 47.54. For Qwen3-8B-Base the corresponding values are 44.06, 52.92, and 56.15. The selected-versus-unselected distributions become much closer in step length under both variants, which is evidence for reducing the stated confounder rather than only improving a benchmark score.

Across the two data sources and four target models, the paper summarizes average accuracy gains over Local LP of about 6.28% for DROP and 9.08% for CASL. On the separate GPQA evaluation, CASL improves Qwen3-4B-Base accuracy from 29.16 for Local LP to 35.35 and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct from 26.13 to 38.51. CASL also consistently exceeds DROP, suggesting that first tokens contain some useful information that should be debiased rather than removed entirely. These results rely on the reported segmentation, probability model, verified-answer collection, and math/science benchmarks; they do not establish that every length correlation is caused only by first tokens.

论文首先显示，四种既有自然性选择器会选出步骤比分池未选部分更长的分布。在 LIMO-v2 上，对 Qwen3-4B-Base，Local LP 的平均准确率为 36.50，ASLEC-DROP 为 44.64，ASLEC-CASL 为 47.54；对 Qwen3-8B-Base，对应数值为 44.06、52.92 和 56.15。在两种变体下，选中与未选数据的步骤长度分布更加接近，这是降低所述混杂因素的证据，而不只是提高基准分数。

跨两个数据来源和四个目标模型，论文概括相对 Local LP 的平均准确率提升约为 DROP 6.28% 和 CASL 9.08%。在独立 GPQA 评测上，CASL 将 Qwen3-4B-Base 的准确率从 Local LP 的 29.16 提升至 35.35，并将 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 从 26.13 提升至 38.51。CASL 还一致超过 DROP，说明首词元含有一些有用信息，应去混杂而非完全移除。这些结果依赖报告的切分、概率模型、正确答案采集和数学/科学基准；它们不证明每种长度相关都只由首词元造成。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier naturalness filters treat a response's average token probability as a direct measure of model-data compatibility. This paper identifies a specific aggregation artifact in that assumption: a repeated low-probability position is normalized away more easily when each reasoning step contains many tokens. The contribution is therefore an audit of the score itself, followed by two corrections that leave the candidate trajectories and target SFT objective otherwise unchanged.

The new element is not selecting high-probability data in general, nor detecting that long answers can be biased. It is locating the bias at step starts and making the first-token ratio an explicit statistical object in selection. DROP tests the simplest removal intervention, while CASL retains first-token information but estimates its confounding contribution. The paired score correction and selected-data distribution analysis are essential because a higher final accuracy alone would not demonstrate that step length has been disentangled.

更早的自然性过滤器将回复的平均词元概率视为模型—数据兼容性的直接度量。本文指出该假设中的特定聚合伪影：当每个推理步骤含有很多词元时，反复出现的低概率位置更容易被归一化掉。因此贡献首先是对分数本身的审计，随后提出两个修正，同时保持候选轨迹和目标监督微调目标不变。

新元素不是一般地选择高概率数据，也不是发现长答案可能有偏差，而是将偏差定位到步骤开头，并使首词元比例成为选择中的显式统计对象。DROP 检验最简单的移除干预，CASL 则保留首词元信息但估计其混杂贡献。成对的分数修正和选中数据分布分析是必要的，因为单独更高的最终准确率并不能证明步骤长度已被解耦。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The analysis identifies first-token probability as a major contributor to step length confounding, but the paper explicitly leaves open whether deeper confounders remain. Its conclusions concern offline, teacher-generated and Math-Verify-filtered SFT data; on-policy generation and selection may have a different relationship to response length. Both the DROP rule and CASL regression depend on reliable step segmentation and a representative target-model probability calculation. Although the official release includes code and generated datasets, reuse should verify upstream LIMO-v2, AceReason, source-model, and benchmark licenses as well as whether manual supplementation of hard LIMO problems changes the selected-data distribution.

分析将首词元概率识别为步骤长度混杂的主要贡献者，但论文明确留下更深混杂因素是否存在的问题。其结论针对离线、教师生成且经 Math-Verify 过滤的监督微调数据；在线策略生成和选择可能与回复长度有不同关系。DROP 规则和 CASL 回归都依赖可靠步骤切分和有代表性的目标模型概率计算。尽管官方发布包含代码和生成数据，复用时仍应核验上游 LIMO-v2、AceReason、来源模型和基准许可证，以及对困难 LIMO 问题的人工补充是否改变了选中数据分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use ASLEC when selecting multi-step reasoning traces by model likelihood and when the selection pipeline can expose step boundaries. Store the segmentation rule, target scoring model revision, source model, generation temperature, correctness verifier, selection ratio, and fitted CASL coefficients with the selected dataset. Compare selected and unselected step-length distributions in addition to downstream accuracy; a score that raises accuracy while still collapsing onto one source or one formatting style may remain biased. CASL is the safer default when first-step transitions may contain useful reasoning information, while DROP is a low-overhead diagnostic control.

当按模型似然选择多步骤推理轨迹，且选择流水线能暴露步骤边界时，可使用 ASLEC。应将切分规则、目标打分模型修订、来源模型、生成温度、正确性验证器、选择比例和拟合的 CASL 系数与选中数据集一同保存。除了下游准确率，还应比较选中和未选数据的步骤长度分布；一个提高准确率却仍塌缩到单一来源或单一格式风格的分数可能仍有偏差。当首步转换可能包含有用推理信息时，CASL 是更安全的默认选择，而 DROP 是低开销的诊断对照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key reading point is that a normalized likelihood is not neutral to how a trajectory is written. In this paper, the score's token average makes the first branch token of each step disproportionately important for short steps and diluted for long ones. The data object is therefore not just an answer trace but a trace plus a segmentation and probability aggregation rule. When auditing a reasoning-data selector, inspect whether a superficial representation feature changes the denominator of its score, then test the selected-data distribution before attributing performance gains to reasoning quality.
关键阅读点是，归一化似然并不对轨迹的书写方式保持中立。在本文中，分数的词元平均使每步的首个分支词元对短步骤不成比例地重要，而在长步骤中被稀释。因此，数据对象不只是答案轨迹，而是轨迹加切分和概率聚合规则。审计推理数据选择器时，应检查表面表示特征是否改变其分数分母，再在将性能收益归因于推理质量之前检验选中数据分布。
